terra_verification.policy: Focused verification allows code tracing, a small reproduction, or a selected existing test; no minimum executed test count.
terra_verification.actual: Terra reported source inspection only, with no tests/builds/linters/provider/network checks. It referred to the read-only checkout and sufficient code tracing.
terra_verification.interpretation: No attempted verification command or demonstrated setup failure explains the omission. Read-only checkout alone does not establish that all focused checks were impossible. The prompt allowed the model to choose source tracing.
terra_verification.future_option: For stateful recovery claims, require a focused executable check where feasible, or explicit evidence-based justification and UNVERIFIED status when material uncertainty remains. Do not require a broad test suite.
